_comment: Post Office landing (Phase 1 preview). Kit/ConvertKit integration arrives in Phase 6.
title: Post Office
intro: Two quiet ways to stay close to the studio — digital notes when something new blooms, and the occasional letter you can hold.

blocks.html: An email list for collection launches, behind-the-scenes glimpses, studio updates, product releases, and special announcements. No noise — just the good stuff.
You can join from the signup form on this site (footer on every page). A dedicated Post Office signup experience is on the way.
For people who like paper: seasonal postcards, studio notes, collection previews, and small surprises in the mail. Signups for physical mail will open here in a later phase.
Email marketing will eventually integrate with Kit (formerly ConvertKit) for gentle segmentation — never spammy blasts.
